newsitem.title: USA: RailTex sees Q1 revs cut by mine collapse.
newsitem.headline: RailTex sees Q1 revs cut by mine collapse.

text.p: RailTex said that the collapse of a mine served by its Cape Breton & Central Nova Scotia Railway Inc unit and flooding in Ohio and northern Kentucky will reduce its first quarter 1997 revenues by about $1.5 million.
The company said its Indiana & Ohio Rail Corp unit was affected by the flooding.
RailTex said it has implemented certain cost reduction measures in response to these events, however it does not expect revenue losses will be significantly mitigated by the anticipated cost savings.

It said the mine collapse in Nova Scotia, which occurred in January, has resulted in temporary suspension of production from the mine. Normal shipments are expected to resume on April 1. The suspension will cause about $1 million in lost revenues.
It said the flooding in Ohio and Kentucky has slowed traffic on its Indiana & Ohio Rail Corp unit, causing about $500,000 in lost revenues.
